value.summary: The diff adds four new model price entries to MODEL_PRICES and four tests that verify pricing behavior. The tests are well-designed: one asserts all default-selected models have prices, another pins the expected cost of a specific model against a real token count, and two specifically guard against swapping the cached/output argument order in completion_cost. I attempted to verify the completion_cost signature and cached-token billing model but the lookup was unavailable; however, the tests themselves are constructed to fail if the argument order is wrong, so the change appears safe to merge.
